Sub: Clarification regarding legal fees payable to panel counsel of EPFAT,

Various High Courts and CAT -Regarding.

Sir,

A number of references have been received. by the Head Office seeking
clarification on the payment of legal fees to the panel advocates. The matter has
been examined and following clarification is issued to all the field offices for
regulating the fees of panel counsels.

2. In this regard, all the offices are aware that the fees of panel advocates are
paid in accordance to the guidelines issued from time to time by Department of Legal
Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice treating our panel counsel at par with Central
Government Counsel /Central Government Standing Counsel /Central Government
Panel Counsel. In view of the recent Office Memorandums issued by Ministry of Law
and Justice including No.26 (1)2011-Judl dated 1.9.2011 and circulated vide
H.O.letter No.LC/2/Information/2006 dated 24.1.2012 it is further clarified that this
circular is guiding the fees only for Senior Central Government Panel Counsels for
various High Courts and CAT Benches, who in case of our offices may be engaged in
selected cases of importance.

3. The payment of fees to EPFO panel advocates in Various High
Courts/CAT/Tribunal including Delhi High Court and except Bombay and Kolkata, shall
continue to be regulated at par with the fee structure of Central Govt. Counsel /Panel
Counsel of High Courts as prescribed vide Office memorandum No. 26(1)2005-Jud|
dated 31.1.2008 of Ministry of Law and Justice, which has not been revised.

4. The payment of fees to EPFAT Panel advocates has to be made at par with
the fee payable to advocates before the CAT which is at par with the High Court as
per enclosed Head Office Circular No.LC/3/9/96/MH/7581 dated 19.4.1999(copy
enclosed) and which may be regulated as per revised O.M.No.26(1)2005-Judl. Dated
31.1.2008.

Yours) faithfully,

OFFICE MEMORANDUM

Subject: Revision of fee payable to Central Government Standing Counsel
/Panel Counsel, Delhi High Court, Asstt. Solicitors General/Central
Government Counsel of various High Courts (including Panel
Counsel of various CAT, Benches) excluding the High Courts of
Bombay and Calcutta.

In partial modification of the terms and conditions contained in OM No.
24(2)/99-Judl., OM No. 26(1)/99-Judl., OM No. 25(3)/99-Judl. and OM No.
26(2)/99-Judl, all dated 24.09.99, the undersigned is directed to convey the approval
of the Competent Authority in the Department of Legal Affairs for revision of the fee
structure as per the statement annexed herewith as Annexure I, in respect of the
Assistant Solicitors General, Central Government Counsel of various High Courts
and of the CAT Benches, but excluding the Panel of the High Courts of Bombay and
Calcutta.

2. The above revised fee will be effective from 01.02.2008.

3. The counsel will be paid fee at the old rates in respect of_their
appearance in the Court etc. and other work done by them prior to 01. 02.2008

and at the revised rates.in respect of the work done by them on/after 01.02.2008

4. This issues with the approval of the Ministry of Finance, Department of
Expenditure E.II(B) Branch, ID Note No. 9(11)/99-E.II dated 6" August, 2007.

(M.A. Khan Yusufi)
